entities.title: Release scripts
entities.summary: The scripts the release workflow runs to work out and stamp the version, train the PGO profile for zazzled's C code, pack the Homebrew bottle, write the zazzle formula and, when configured, sign and notarize the macOS binaries; the version, bottle, formula and signing scripts have tests that run in CI.
entities.purpose: Holds version.sh (the release's tag, version and whether to publish, from the tags and the bump), set-version.sh (writes the version into every crate's manifest and Cargo.lock entry), pgo.sh (a clang profile for tree-sitter's C code in zazzled), bottle.sh (the zazzle bottle from the release files), formula.sh (Formula/zazzle.rb for the tap), sign-and-notarize.sh (Developer ID signature and Apple notarization, with entitlements/NAME.plist for a binary that needs them: zazz-worker's executable memory for WebAssembly), their tests version.test.sh, formula.test.sh and sign-and-notarize.test.sh, and README.md, the owner's guide to version numbers, the formula, PGO and signing.
boundaries: The workflows that run these scripts are .github/workflows/release.yml and, for pgo.sh, zazzle-bench.yml.
The formula is written into a checkout of the external tap zazzcat/homebrew-z, not into this repository.
